title: The Dust and Molecular Gas in the Brightest Cluster Galaxy in MACS 1931.8-2635
question: What are the amount, distribution, kinematics and excitation of the molecular gas and dust in the BCG of the cool-core cluster MACS 1931, and how do they relate to the AGN, star formation and the ICM?

data.bands: Bands 3, 6, 7 (12 m and ACA for 6 and 7)

what.value: ICM temperature 4.78±0.64 keV, cooling rate, entropy and X-ray cavities

evidence.quote: substantially colder than the $4.78\pm0.64$ keV temperature of the ICM plasma around the multiphase tail

what.value: SFR, burst duration and dust mass of the BCG

evidence.quote: the SFR = $240^{+197}_{-70}$ M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$ and we constrained the duration of the starburst to be $74^{+145}_{-30}$ Myr

what.value: CO SLED comparison samples (SMG, ULIRG averages)

evidence.quote: The SMG (blue points) and local ULIRG averages (grey points) are derived from the samples studied in (cite: 2015Daddi_CO)

recipe.method: Regenerate pipeline calibration, concat per band, uvcontsub

recipe.goal: Image continuum and cubes; remove AGN point source
recipe.method: clean MFS continuum; fitcomponents Gaussian point-source fit and subtraction; line cubes at 25 km/s

recipe.goal: Fit CO line spectra and compute gas mass
recipe.method: Lorentzian profile fits to integrated spectra and knots; M_mol from CO(1-0) flux
R_ij brightness-temperature ratios, global and pixel map of R31 where S/N>=3
Band7/Band6 flux ratio vs greybody with CMB correction, as function of T_d and beta
key_parameters: lambda_0 = 200 um; rest wavelengths 640 and 892 um
assumptions: beta 1.22-1.98 (1.6±0.38); T_CMB = 3.69 K; power-law term neglected

evidence.quote: the CO(1-0) line has an integrated flux of $3.45 \pm 0.47$ Jy km s$^{-1}$
the CO(3-2) line has a flux of $29.0 \pm 2.8$ Jy km s$^{-1}$
the CO(4-3) line has a flux of $33.7 \pm 3.5$ Jy km s$^{-1}$
The Band 7 to Band 6 flux ratios for these regions are $1.25\pm0.53$, $3.29\pm0.99$, and $1.29\pm0.33$, respectively.
we find that $5.0 < T_d < 21.9$ K for $\beta = 1.6\pm0.38$
imply the molecular gas has a depletion time of $\sim 80$ Myr

not_stated_but_needed: Clean threshold and iteration counts, mask definitions
Taper parameters beyond 1.5'' and common-beam sizes
Lorentzian fitting method and priors, and how spectra regions are defined
Region definitions for dust flux ratios and temperature-limit derivation method
Rest frequencies used and velocity reference
Simulated BCG data source for velocity dispersion comparison
score_reason: Archive data and standard CASA steps, but many imaging and fitting details are unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe is mostly standard, and results are numeric (line fluxes, gas mass, flux ratios).
